about.heroDescription: Saudade is not only a brand. It is the shape that love takes when it decides to build something lasting.
about.welcomeText1: Saudade is not only a sustainable fashion brand dedicated to elevate the spirit and inspire conscious living; Saudade is a movement!
about.welcomeText2: Saudade is a gathering of kindred spirits, united by a shared passion for celebrating life, making a meaningful impact, and inspiring others to live sustainably and consciously.
about.meaningTitle: A feeling, a sensation, a call for awareness.
about.meaningText1: Saudade has no direct translation; it is more than a word. It is the deep longing for meaningful connection, the will to reach out, and the energy that bridges the distance between hearts.
about.meaningText2: It can be longing, nostalgia, love, even heartbreak - always profound and immensely powerful. Saudade is the aspiration for greatness and genuine connection with ourselves, nature, and the universe itself.
about.meaningText3: With love and joy, Mayka presents this vision: a future of integrity, tolerance, harmony, determination, and love.
about.visionTitle: A conscious living sanctuary and regenerative community.
about.visionText1: The vision is to establish self-sustaining hubs across the world, starting in Brazil and eventually expanding to every continent.
about.visionText2: These sanctuaries become living examples where renewable energy, permaculture, and circular economies replace exploitation and waste.
about.inspirationTitle: The project is inspired by the need for positive change, unity, and transcendence into a new world.
about.inspirationText: With love for nature and the cultures that brought us to this present moment.
about.originTitle: We were born in South America.
about.originText1: Brazil, Bolivia, Ecuador — they shaped us. We grew up understanding that there is more to this world than what we see. That we are made of energy. That we are connected in ways most people forget. That understanding never left.
about.originText2: I was a passionate child — intensely alive, with an incredible inner drive and a talent I didn't yet have words for. Life asked me to grow up fast, and I did — not out of resignation, but out of sheer will. At fourteen, done waiting for a different reality, I left. Not running away. Moving forward. That quality — that refusal to stay where the energy is wrong — has shaped everything that came after.
about.originImageAlt: Mayka, Adair and their sister as children
about.adairTitle: Adair — the artist behind the art.
about.adairText1: Adair is my brother and the artist behind every print you'll find in the Saudade shop. His work is not decorative — it is visionary. Born from a mind that sees the world differently, each piece carries a frequency all its own.
about.adairText2: Adair has always been an artist. Before words, before the world made sense — there was art. Drawing was his language. Painting was his prayer. Every line, a step back toward himself.
about.adairText3: Diagnosed with schizophrenia and other rare conditions, he moved through realities none of us could follow. The institutions meant to help sedated him, experimented on him, and returned him more lost than before. For years, the system failed him. He was too different, too vast, too much for a world that hadn't yet learned to make space for minds like his.
about.adairText4: What finally reached him was not found inside those walls. It was nature. Natural medicine. The quiet discipline of making something beautiful with his hands. Slowly, on his own terms, he found his way back to himself. He found peace. He found purpose. And he found the courage to share his visions with the world.
about.adairText5: His dream is simple and complete: a small piece of land where he can build his home, tend his garden, have a studio where he can keep creating his art, and live a peaceful life. The pieces I carry in the shop exist to help make that dream real — to help him buy land in Costa Rica, continue the natural medicines that truly heal him, and one day be close to the family he loves.
about.maykaText1: While Adair healed through art, I was searching for my own path. Life took me on roads I never could have imagined — each one a challenge, each one a teacher. I have always needed to work with passion; every job I ever took, I took because I loved it. When the idea of building a brand first came to me, it took real courage to believe that was possible for me. The ordinary world didn't seem to have a place for me. So I decided to build one.
about.maykaText2: Making that decision, I began to reconnect to my childhood — and to remember. My memory isn't always kind to me; trauma has its own way of taking things. But I remembered this: as a little girl, I was already drawing clothes, making up stories about them for my little sister — who has always been my light. That child never stopped creating. Reconnecting to her gave me everything.
about.maykaText3: Saudade was born from that necessity — and from something ancient. Clothing, to me, is not just fabric. It is a vessel. My signature piece, a kimono robe designed as an energy protector cape, draws from Andean wisdom and the Chakana — the sacred cross of the Inca, representing the three worlds: the upper, the inner, and the outer. A reminder that we are made of energy, that we are connected, and that we can always choose to elevate.
about.maykaText4: Saudade — the word itself — has no direct translation. It is the deep longing for meaningful connection, the energy that bridges the distance between hearts. It can be nostalgia, love, even heartbreak — always profound, always expanding. It is the aspiration for genuine connection with ourselves, with nature, with the universe. That is what this brand is built on. Not a trend. A feeling that has always existed, finally given a home.
about.maykaQuote: If you're reading this, you're already part of it.
about.landTitle: Saudade Land — a place for those who never quite had one.
about.landText1: Behind everything I do lies a dream: a permaculture sanctuary where artists, healers, and dreamers can gather, collaborate, and build something lasting together. A place for Adair to have his garden and his home. A place for us — the siblings who looked after each other when no one else did. A place for everyone who, like us, never quite found where they belonged.
about.landText2: The vision is to establish self-sustaining hubs across the world, starting in Brazil — living examples where renewable energy, permaculture, and circular economies replace exploitation and waste. Saudade is only the first step.
about.landText3: When you support Adair's art or wear my designs, you are not just buying a product. You are helping build that dream. Every purchase is a step toward Saudade Land.
about.closingQuote: We came here to love the world back to life. You found us because part of you never forgot.
about.maykaText5: Caring for the ones I love has always been at the centre of who I am. Every decision I have made points toward the same dream — and that dream has grown far beyond a fashion brand. It is today the Saudade project.

saudadeLand.heroSubtitle: Born in Portugal. Rooted in Brazil. Expanding beyond.
saudadeLand.questionTitle: What does your healthy, vibrant life on this planet look like?
saudadeLand.questionText1: We are capable of so much more than what modern life has been asking of us. Something in us already knows this. That longing for real connection, real nature, real purpose — it is not a problem to solve. It is a compass.
saudadeLand.questionText2: Saudade Land is not a belief, not a religion, not an escape. It is a living experiment in what becomes possible when we choose to build differently — meeting real needs while regenerating land, culture, and meaning.
saudadeLand.portugalText1: Saudade is a Portuguese word. There is no translation — only the feeling. It is the longing for what is beautiful. It is the pull of what you love, across distance and time. It is the ache of the Atlantic. It is the force that built bridges between continents.
saudadeLand.portugalText2: Portugal is where this project finds its soul. A land at the edge of Europe that once connected entire worlds — carrying people, culture, and meaning across the ocean. That spirit lives here still. This is where the first Saudade Land takes root: a community node on Portuguese soil, accessible to Europe, open to the Atlantic, ancient in its earth.
saudadeLand.brazilText1: Brazil remains one of the few places on Earth where a project like this is still possible at scale. Immense biodiversity, fertile soil, abundant water and sunlight — and a people with ancestral wisdom still alive in their hands and hearts.
saudadeLand.brazilText2: Brazil is the foundation. From here, the model expands organically into Bolivia, Colombia, and other regions — integrating ancestral wisdom, land stewardship, and cultural exchange until the network becomes contagious.
saudadeLand.build1Text: Permaculture systems, food forests, and soil restoration — building land that gives more than it takes.
saudadeLand.build2Text: Community housing and tiny homes designed for conscious living, short-term stays, and investor ownership.
saudadeLand.build3Text: Organic farming, permaculture workshops, and local food systems that feed the community and the surrounding area.
saudadeLand.build4Text: Skill-sharing circles, workshops, and learning outside failing conventional systems — teaching real self-sufficiency.
saudadeLand.build5Text: Festivals, rituals, and collective experiences that celebrate beauty, music, and the full spectrum of human expression.
saudadeLand.build6Text: A home base for independent thinkers, healers, and creators — where your ideas have a place and space to grow.
saudadeLand.visionTitle: We are Saudade — A Global Sanctuary for the New Earth
saudadeLand.visionText: We cannot change the world alone. But we can build sanctuaries where love, unity, and harmony with nature thrive. This land is the first node in a global network.
saudadeLand.vision1Text: Proof that a community rooted in truth can regenerate land while generating meaning, livelihood, and joy.
saudadeLand.vision2Text: From here to other countries in Latin America, then every continent — until the model becomes contagious.
saudadeLand.vision3Text: Where your ideas find family, collaboration, and purpose. A space where you are not alone.
saudadeLand.realText: There will be work, conflict, and accountability. What makes this different is structure — clear agreements, contribution-based participation, transparent governance, and shared responsibility.
saudadeLand.impact5: Cultural bridges built on common purpose
saudadeLand.familyTitle: The family you have been searching for
saudadeLand.familyText1: You will be part of a growing international community of like-minded, independent thinkers. A home for those ready to live with responsibility, humility, and courage — in service of life itself.
saudadeLand.familyText2: Your ideas have a place here. Your energy has a purpose. You are not here to consume — you are here to co-create.
saudadeLand.familyQuote: Not real estate. The birth of a new world.
saudadeLand.networkText: By 2030, the goal is to be rooted and growing — a real, living community, not a finished vision, but a beginning. Unity is of utmost importance. Together, we can help one another — especially children, the future. We cannot promise to change the world. But we can build something true, and show that a different way is possible.
saudadeLand.closingQuote: We cannot change the world. But we can inspire — and show that a different way is possible.
saudadeLand.closingText: Saudade Land is not for everyone. It is for those ready to live with intention, to contribute honestly, and to be part of something that matters.
saudadeLand.portugalText3: Saudade was born from this crossing. I grew up in South America — shaped by its land, its people, and the ancient wisdom still alive there. I moved to Europe at sixteen, carrying both worlds inside me ever since. Portugal is the meeting point where those worlds converge. The bridge is not between hemispheres — it is between what is most alive, most true, and most human in all of us.

fashionPage.metaTitle: Chaka Arcana — High Frequency Fashion by Saudade
fashionPage.metaDescription: Five sacred kimonos. Five portals. One bridge between worlds. The inaugural Chaka Arcana Collection by Saudade Creative Studio — wearable talismans born from the ancient wisdom of South America.
fashionPage.story1Lead: There is a word in Portuguese that has no direct translation in any other language.
fashionPage.story1Rest: It is the ache of longing for something or someone deeply loved — a place, a time, a feeling. It lives in the body as much as in the heart.
fashionPage.story2: This collection was born from that feeling.
fashionPage.story3: I grew up traveling. Mainly across Latin America and Europe — woven into cultures ancient beyond memory, rooted in soil that still remembers the sacred. I learned from the land, from the people, from the invisible world that pulses beneath every stone and river and star.
fashionPage.story4Pre: In Bolivia, I lived close to the
fashionPage.story4Mid: — the Andean stepped cross, spiritual map of indigenous Andean cultures for thousands of years. It is a living cosmological diagram: the four directions, the three worlds. It is the bridge.
fashionPage.story5: That word — Chaka, bridge — became the soul of this project.
fashionPage.story6: Latin America is a land of staggering beauty and depth, holding a wisdom protected against every attempt to erase it. Many of its people are living through difficult times. The whole world feels like chaos and uncertainty right now. That is why I wanted to make something to lift our spirits — to reconnect us with what is sacred, and give us strength and protection. So this isn’t just a kimono. It is an energy protector. A bridge — between cultures, between continents, building a circle of support. To Bolivia and Ecuador and to everyone walking a hard road right now: I stand with you, and my hope is that relief and justice find you soon.
fashionPage.story7Pre: Each kimono is also a message:
fashionPage.story7Rest: May the old knowledge keep walking. May we remember, and protect, and rise together.
fashionPage.story8: And with it, the Saudade project begins.
fashionPage.story9Pre: Everything is energy — and fabric carries energy too. That is why I created
fashionPage.story9Rest: : garments made to move in harmony with your body, your spirit, and the living world. Natural, breathable, alive.
fashionPage.story10: The art prints are hand-painted in collaboration with an artist from Ecuador, Sarahi, and an artist from Bolivia, Anki — dear and talented friends. Only 100 of each in existence.
fashionPage.def1Meaning: The sacred Andean cross — a stepped symbol encoding the four directions, four seasons, four elements, and the three worlds. The bridge between all that exists.
fashionPage.def2Meaning: Hidden mysteries — the secret sacred knowledge that has always existed beneath the surface of things, waiting to be remembered.

k1.tagline: The sacred cross. The four directions. The living map of all that exists.
k1.frequency: In collaboration with the wonderful Ecuadorian artist Sarahi.
k1.colors: Earth green · Ocean blue · Fire orange · Spirit gold
k1.description: The Chakana is the oldest symbol of the Andes — a stepped cross encoding the four directions, the four seasons, the four elements, and the three worlds: the underworld, the earth, and the cosmos above. This kimono is that symbol made wearable. Its electric geometry pulses with green earth, blue water, red fire, and gold spirit — not as decoration, but as cosmology. Every line is a map. Every color is a force. To wear Chakana is to carry the whole living world on your body.
k1.wear: A wearable portal to the mysteries of the natural world. Wear it as a protector cape, a frequency field, a declaration that you walk in alignment with the living world.

k2.tagline: The secret code of the weaving goddess.
k2.colors: Deep dark ground · Teal blue · Cascading gold
k2.description: The most mysterious piece in the collection — a deep, encrypted cosmos of dark golds, teal blues, and diagonal lattice patterns that seem to pulse with hidden writing. Named for Ixchel, the Mayan goddess of the moon, weaving, and feminine creative power. The gold linework cascades across near-black like sacred script waiting to be decoded.
k2.wear: Wear it when you need to access hidden wisdom, protect your creative power, or move through the world as a keeper of ancient knowledge.

k3.tagline: The fire of the sacred cross. The burning bridge between worlds.
k3.colors: Deep crimson · Burning gold · Shadow ground
k3.description: The heart of the collection — fire made fabric. Deep crimson, gold, and shadow pulse with the ancient Andean Chakana cross at its center, surrounded by radiating arcs and botanical linework. This is the guardian: fierce, warm, deeply protective. Its reds speak of transformation through fire — not destruction but purification.
k3.wear: Wear it when you need the fire of the earth to walk beside you. When you need a guardian at your back. When you are ready to be purified and elevated.

k4.tagline: The blue world. The cosmos alive.
k4.frequency: In collaboration with my dear friend, the talented Bolivian artist Anki.
k4.colors: Deep indigo · Neon botanical · Cosmic black
k4.description: The dreamer of the collection — a deep indigo cosmos where botanical forms float like constellations and neon linework traces the invisible connections between all living things. Sunflowers and sacred geometry suspended in cosmic blue. The frequency of expanded consciousness — the understanding, without words, that you are infinite.
k4.wear: Wear it when you need to remember you are made of stars. When you need the protection of perspective — your infinite nature, revealed.

k5.tagline: The green world. The living earth in full bloom.
k5.frequency: In collaboration with my dear friend, the talented Bolivian artist Anki.
k5.colors: Deep green-black · Neon botanical · Blazing gold
k5.description: The healer of the collection — an eruption of neon botanical life on a deep green-black ground, vibrating with the frequency of growth, regeneration, and unstoppable natural abundance. Where Pacha Azul looks to the cosmos, Pacha Verde is rooted in the earth. Its sunflowers blaze, its leaf forms cascade, its central mandala pulses with flowering life.
k5.wear: Wear it when you need restoration. When you need to be reminded that growth is inevitable, that the earth’s intelligence is always working on your behalf.
